property_tests.description: For any session with any number of token_usage records, the totals field in GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/usage always equals the SUM of all token_usage rows regardless of pagination page or time range.

property_tests.invariant_check: For each page, assert page.body.totals.total_input_tokens == db.query('SELECT SUM(input_tokens) FROM token_usage WHERE session_id=?', session_id); assert this holds on every page regardless of cursor position

property_tests.description: For any sequence of paginated requests to GET /api/v1/sessions or GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/usage, the union of all pages equals the full result set with no duplicated or skipped records even under concurrent inserts.

property_tests.invariant_check: allReturnedIDs = union of IDs from all pages; assert len(allReturnedIDs) == len(set(allReturnedIDs)) (no duplicates); assert all pre-existing IDs appear in allReturnedIDs (no skips for records that existed before pagination started)

property_tests.description: For any workspace with a mix of active and terminal sessions, force-close sets status=terminated only on sessions with status=active and never modifies sessions in any terminal state.
